image.alt: Lampu Hadapan LED Tampil Lebih Bergaya

y16zr.title: Dengan Twin Funnel
y16zr.description: Sistem Twin Funnel Intake menghasilkan bunyi sedutan enjn yang lebih garang untuk pengalaman tunggangan yang lebih mengujakan.

y16zr.title: Yang Lebih Berteknologi

y16zr.title: Dengan Identiti Khas
y16zr.description: Corak grafik eksklusif dengan efek khas menyerlahkan karakter sporty dan identiti premium Y16ZR-R.

y16zr.title: Kawalan Maksimum
y16zr.description: Traction Control System membantu meningkatkan cengkaman tayar ketika memecut untuk tunggangan yang lebih stabil dan yakin.

y16zr.title: Untuk Kawalan Penuh
y16zr.description: Sistem ABS membantu mengelakkan tayar daripada terkunci ketika membrek, memberikan kawalan yang lebih yakin dalam pelbagai keadaan.

y15zr.title: LED Modern Headlights
y15zr.description: An updated design that is sophisticated and sporty, the new LED headlights consist of 3 parts (2 lows, 1 high) each providing maximum clarity lighting during riding.

y15zr.title: Wider Front Tyre
y15zr.description: Now a more macho look with a wider front tyre, giving you a safer and a more comfortable ride.

y15zr.title: LCD Meter Panel
y15zr.description: The new speedometer design features a full LCD meter panel with brighter and comprehensive riding information, all in the palm of your hands.

y15zr.title: Attractive Graphics and Decals
y15zr.description: The combination of today’s fascinating modern graphic design and decals, adding the sparks to your ride. It looks fast even standing still.

135lc-fi.title: Tempat Duduk
135lc-fi.description: Dengan memusingkan kunci ke kiri, anda kini boleh membuka tempat duduk dengan mudah tanpa perlu menarik keluar kunci.

135lc-fi.description: Reka bentuk cowling baharu meningkatkan kecekapan aerodinamik, mengurangkan geseran serta tekanan angin di bahagian lutut untuk tunggangan lancar.

135lc-fi.title: Lampu Pilot Baharu
135lc-fi.description: Rekaan baharu lampu hadapan serta lampu pilot melengkapi bentuk agresif keseluruhan Yamaha 135LC Fi ini.

image.alt: Lampu Hadapan LED & Lampu Pilot Baharu

135lc-fi.title: Belakang Baharu

135lc-fi.title: Belakang LED

yzf-r25.title: Aggressive New YZF-R1 Inspired Face
yzf-r25.description: With a glaring new look and face, a new front fairing and screen inspired by the iconic YZF-R1, the R25 has a central air duct working with the cross-layered panels to maximize cooling airflow for the engine, making this the most outstanding compact super sport in its class.

image.alt: Liquid-Cooled, Aggressive New YZF-R1 Inspired Face

yzf-r25.title: YZF-R1 Inspired Dual LED Headlights
yzf-r25.description: The new front fairing now carries a YZF-R1 style set of headlights that underline the R25’s strong genetic looks with the larger R-series. With bright and long lasting LED technology, it enhances both visibility and illumination with minimal power draw, yet giving the bike a radical new look.

image.alt: Dual YZF-R1 Inspired Dual LED Headlights

yzf-r25.title: 3 in 1 Main Switch Design Inspired by Big Bikes
yzf-r25.description: Featuring an ala Big Bike switch, with the starter button and a 3 in 1 cut off/on on board.

image.alt: Super Sport 3 in 1 Main Switch Design Inspired by Big Bikes

yzf-r25.title: YZR-M1 Inspired Look
yzf-r25.description: The YZF-R25’s new bodywork and ergonomics is a sleeker, now on more aerodynamics and refined. Inspired by the MotoGP’s YZR-M1, this compact bike sports rac-bred look and ready to attack on the road and track.

yzf-r25.title: Updated Digital Multi-Function Instrument
yzf-r25.description: The YZF-R25 features an updated multi-function and compact LCD instrument that furnishes the rider of the gear positions, fuel capacity, real time and average fuel economy, water temperature, clock and an oil change trip meter.

image.alt: Aluminium Cast Updated Digital Multi-Function Instrument

yzf-r25.title: New Inverted Front Forks
yzf-r25.description: With optimised spring and damping settings, improving fork rigidity for a sporty front-end feel without losing the real-world comfort when riding.

tmax.title: Stop Signal (ESS)
tmax.description: Extra safety, when it matters most.

tmax.title: + T-Shaped Position Lights
tmax.description: Redesigned for sharper, sportier lines, the TMAX now boasts dual-eye headlights and restyled front end that screams performance.

image.alt: Sleek New Front Fairing + T-Shaped Position Lights

tmax.title: Seat Cover
tmax.description: Comfort meets class. A fresh seat design that elevates every ride.

tmax.title: Max Control
tmax.description: Cruise control. Traction + Brake Control. Dual D-MODE.

tmax.title: Monitoring System (TPMS)
tmax.description: Real-time tyre data at your fingertips.

tmax.title: Cut Wheels
tmax.description: Because premium isn’t just about looks, it’s how it rolls.

tenere-700.title: AND BODY DESIGN
tenere-700.description: Inspired by Yamaha’s rally heritage, the new design keeps the classic Tenere silhouette with a tall, vertical front and slim, lightweight rear. The iconic quad LED headlamp has been redesigned for a sharper, more aggressive look while delivering improved visibility for night riding.

image.alt: NEW RALLY – BRED HEADLIGHT AND BODY DESIGN

tenere-700.title: FOUR – STROKE CP2 ENGINE
tenere-700.description: The latest Tenere 700 is powered by Yamaha’s acclaimed 690cc CP2 engine, now updated with YCC-T electronic throttle for smoother response and improved torque delivery. Updates include a new air intake, smoother gearshift, and a redesigned clutch cover that offers better legroom when riding seated or standing.

image.alt: LATEST EU5 + 690CC FOUR – STROKE CP2 ENGINE

tenere-700.title: ADJUSTABLE SUSPENSION
tenere-700.description: Long travel suspension gives the Tenere 700 its commanding stance and 240mm ground clearance. The 43mm front forks are now fully adjustable with a new preload adjuster, while the rear features a fully adjustable shock with piggyback reservoir for improved performance in tough riding conditions.

tenere-700.title: AT THE PRESS OF A BUTTON
tenere-700.description: For greater control off road, both ABS and traction control can be switched off at the press of a button. The ABS system offers three modes: fully on, fully off, or front wheel only, allowing riders to use the rear brake to steer on loose surfaces while retaining front wheel ABS for added confidence.

image.alt: SWITCHABLE ABS AND TCS AT THE PRESS OF A BUTTON

pg-1.title: Belakang Ikonik
pg-1.description: Lampu depan dan belakang berbentuk bulat yang ringkas dan ikonik menjadi pelengkap rekabentuk bergaya model ini.

pg-1.title: Kerusi Terpisah
pg-1.description: Penutup tangki bahan api terletak di bawah tempat duduk penunggang, menjadikan pengisian bahan api lebih mudah apabila bagasi dimuatkan pada bahagian tempat duduk penumpang.

pg-1.title: Suspensi Depan
pg-1.description: Memberi perlindungan tambahan daripada kotoran ketika menunggang.

pg-1.title: Pemegang Tegak
pg-1.description: Membolehkan posisi tunggangan lebih santai dengan mengoptimumkan ketinggian dan lebar bahagian komponen.

pg-1.title: Suntikan Bahan Api
pg-1.description: Selain daripada ketahanan dan kestabilan, enjin ini juga memberikan keseimbangan antara prestasi tork, kemudahan penggunaan dan penggunaan bahan api yang rendah.

pg-1.title: Bercorak Blok
pg-1.description: Tayar bercorak blok memberikan kestabilan yang baik sama ada di jalanraya mahupun di luar jalanraya.

tracer-9-gt.title: FOR RIDER AND PILLION
tracer-9-gt.description: Designed for longer journey and shared adventures, the Tracer 9 GT offers enhanced comfort for both rider and pillion. A new subframe that is 50 mm longer creates more space, while flatter more generously padded seats and a revised handlebar position deliver a more relaxed, natural riding posture. The saddle is also shaped slimmer at the standover point, making the bike more accessible and easier to handle at a standstill. Together, these thoughtful refinements reduce fatigue, improve confidence, and make every ride feel lighter, calmer and more enjoyable.

image.alt: MORE COMFORTABLE ERGONOMICS FOR RIDER AND PILLION

tracer-9-gt.title: KEY SYSTEM
tracer-9-gt.description: Enjoy keyless convenience with Yamaha’s Smart Key System. With the key fob in your pocket, you can start the Tracer 9 GT without a physical ignition key, while central locking and unlocking controls the steering lock and fuel cap.

tracer-9-gt.title: QUICK SHIFTER
tracer-9-gt.description: Enjoy smoother, more effortless riding with the 3rd generation quick shifter, delivering clutchless upshifts and downshifts for a more fluid ride experience. Designed to work from speeds as low as 15 km/h, it enables upshifts from 2,000 rpm and downshifts from 1,600 rpm, making every gear change feel natural and precise. The system can also be switched off, giving riders full control to suit their personal riding style.

tracer-9-gt.title: ADJUSTABLE WINDSCREEN
tracer-9-gt.description: Ride in comfort across changing conditions with the electronically adjustable windscreen. Redesigned front fairing and windscreen geometry, refined through wind tunnel testing, deliver improved wind protection and reduced fatigue, allowing riders to fine tune airflow at the touch of a button for a calmer, more relaxed ride.

tracer-9-gt.title: CONTROLLED SUSPENSION
tracer-9-gt.description: Developed jointly with KYB specifically for the Tracer 9 GT, this is the most advanced suspension system ever fitted to a Yamaha production model. Linked to Yamaha Ride Control (YRC), it automatically adjusts damping force in real time to suit road conditions and riding modes, delivering exceptional comfort, stability and confidents across every journey.

tracer-9-gt.title: WITH CONNECTIVITY & GARMIN NAVIGATION WITH NEW 7-INCH FULL COLOUR TFT DISPLAY
tracer-9-gt.description: The new 7-inch full colour TFT display brings together ride control, connectivity and navigation in one intelligent system. Yamaha Ride Control (YRC) allows riders to tailor engine power and electronic rider aid intervention to suit road conditions and personal preferences, with three preset modes (SPORT, STREET and RAIN) and two custom modes (CUSTOM 1 and CUSTOM 2) for a fully personalised ride experience. By pairing your smartphone via the Y-Connect app, you can view key information and adjust YRC settings directly from your phone, while the Garmin StreetCross app projects a full Garmin navigation system onto the screen, keeping your route clear, your hands on the bars and your focus on the road.

image.alt: YAMAHA RIDE CONTROL (YRC) WITH CONNECTIVITY & GARMIN NAVIGATION WITH NEW 7-INCH FULL COLOUR TFT DISPLAY

ego-avantiz.description: A generous 14L under-seat storage compartment to hold your personal items including a jet-type helmet.

ez115.description: Enjin Fi EU4 yang berprestasi, mengeluarkan kuasa kuat di kelasnya, mulus dan mudah diselenggara serta sudah terbukti sebagai juara di litar perlumbaan di kategori CP115.

mt-09.title: WITH A DEDICATED CRUISE CONTROL
mt-09.description: With just a convenient click, the new intuitive control switch can handle a wide range of functions, including smartphone connectivity, navigation and cruise control.

image.alt: INTUITIVE CONTROL SWITCH WITH A DEDICATED CRUISE CONTROL

mt-09.title: WITH Y-CONNECT & GARMIN STREETCROSS
mt-09.description: The 5-inch full-color TFT display is updated with four customisable themes and smartphone connectivity via the Y-connect app, allowing riders to receive calls, texts, and listen to music. Real-time traffic updates and full map navigation can be accessed through the free Garmin StreetCross app.

image.alt: 5-INCH TFT FULL COLOUR DISPLAY WITH Y-CONNECT & GARMIN STREETCROSS

mt-09.title: Slipper Clutch
mt-09.description: Assist and slipper clutch is adopted to reduce the weight of the clutch pull and provide low-stress shifting during deceleration. It provides a smoother ride, the gear shift is lighter and the quicker acceleration.

mt-09.title: GRILLES
mt-09.description: Amplifier grilles are specially designed with perforated openings above the fuel tank to accentuate the high frequency sounds of the engine, delivering an exhilarating sound of speed right to the rider’s ears.

mt-09.title: VIA YAMAHA RIDE CONTROL (YRC)
mt-09.description: The Yamaha Ride Control (YRC) offers three preset riding modes-SPORT, STREET, and RAIN-plus two customizable options for engine power and electronic intervention, all adjustable via the TFT screen or through the Y-CONNECT app.

image.alt: PERSONALIZED RIDING MODES VIA YAMAHA RIDE CONTROL (YRC)

mt-09.title: Tail Light
mt-09.description: LED technology provides brighter lighting with better energy savings and longer lasting.

mt-09.title: MASTER CYLINDER
mt-09.description: The Brembo radial master cylinder delivers a linear pressure supply to the four-piston calipers on the dual 298mm front discs, providing outstanding braking performance with fingertip control.

mt-09.title: USB TYPE-C
mt-09.description: A standard Type C port for charging mobile and portable devices.

mt-09.description: The subframe has been redesigned to improve the rider’s stability while the spring rate has been increased to ensure better handling and cornering performance across various road conditions.

mt-09.title: AND TWO-PART SEAT
mt-09.description: The redesigned fuel tank is now slimmer for a forward-learning riding position while the 2-part seat has been upgraded to provide comfort for both rider and passenger.

image.alt: RESHAPED FUEL TANK AND TWO-PART SEAT

mt-09.title: Front Suspension
mt-09.description: USD front fork with strength-rigidity balance offers better handling, stability, control and style.

mt-09.title: FOR BETTER RIDING ERGONOMICS
mt-09.description: Both the handlebars and footrests can now be adjusted to two positions to suit the rider’s physique for enhanced comfort and better overall control of the bike.

image.alt: ADJUSTABLE HANDLEBAR AND FOOTPEGS FOR BETTER RIDING ERGONOMICS

r15m.description: Gandingan tayar ini meningkat tahap cengkaman maksima semasa selekoh dan keyakinan lebih tinggi.

r15m.title: Depan Terbalik
r15m.description: Rasai tunggangan penuh sensasi dengan teknologi fork jenis USD yang hadir dengan kemasan berwarna emas untuk gayaan lebih dinamik.

xmax-250.title: Stop Signal (ESS)
xmax-250.description: Smart signals that flash under hard braking so others around you react faster, when seconds matter.

xmax-250.title: Traction Control
xmax-250.description: Smoother grip. More confident handling, rain or shine.

xmax-250.title: Charging Port
xmax-250.description: Power up your devices with the modern standard.

xmax-250.title: Windshield
xmax-250.description: Adjust on the go for comfort that keeps up with your ride.

xmax-250.description: Smoother airflow. Sleeker profile. Sharper awareness.

yseries.title: Depan Terbaru
yseries.description: Rekaan hadapan lebih agresif menyerlahkan simbol kuasa dan juga memberi makna tersendiri kepada mereka yang berani.

yseries.title: Dengan Latar Negatif
yseries.description: Panel unit digital LCD baharu yang memaparkan informasi seperti kelajuan, tahap RPM, kedudukan gear, penunjuk VVA dan lain-lain.

yseries.title: Kunci Pintar
yseries.description: Enjin boleh dihidupkan dengan memutar butang tanpa perlu memasukkan kunci.

yseries.title: Brek ‘ABS’
yseries.description: Sistem brek ‘ABS’ serta piring depan lebih besar digabungkan bagi memberi kuasa pengendalian lebih dinamik dan keyakinan dalam setiap tunggangan.

mt-15.title: Meter Panel
mt-15.description: Negative LCD meter panel features easy to read multi-function display with a range of information.

mt-15.title: Front Fork
mt-15.description: High Quality inverted front forks with cast aluminium upper triple clamp gives excellent agility and quick cornering response.

mt-15.title: Lever Pull and Stress-Free Gear Shifts
mt-15.description: An A&S (assist and slipper) clutch adopted to reduce the weight of the clutch pull and provide low-stress shifting during deceleration. The lighter clutch pull weight helps to reduce rider fatigue. This also prevents excessive engine braking, this reducing the effects on chassis behavior. This A&S clutch makes for quick, smooth downshifts.

image.alt: A&S Clutch for Lighter Lever Pull and Stress-Free Gear Shifts

mt-15.title: Rear Tyre
mt-15.description: Mounted with wide 140mm rear tyres for excellent grip and sure road holding.

mt-15.title: Tail Light
mt-15.description: LED technology provides brighter lighting with better energy savings and longer lasting.

mt-15.title: & LED Headlight
mt-15.description: Twin eyed Position and LED Headlight. Aggressive twin LED position lights gives an intimidating MT look, the compact central mounted LED headlight brightens every night ride.

mt-15.title: Gear Box
mt-15.description: With an optimized secondary reduction gear ratio, the 6 speed gear box delivers a smooth ride.

mt-15.title: Lamps
mt-15.description: First in its class hazard lamp for use during emergency situation.

mt-15.title: VVA Engine
mt-15.description: 155cc liquid-cooled, SOHC, 4-valve, fuel-injected engine with high-performance VVA system integrating specific ECU with optimized FI settings produces high torque acceleration.

mt-15.title: Front Disc
mt-15.description: A 2 pot calliper paired with large 282mm front disc gives accurate and strong braking power.

mt-15.title: Front Suspension
mt-15.description: USD front fork with strength-rigidity balance offers better handling, stability, control and style.

y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.title: Glow-in-the-Dark Emblem
y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.description: Stand out in any light. A one of a kind, glow in the dark emblem enhances Y16ZR’s presence, ensuring the brand’s dominance day or night.

y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.title: Effect
y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.description: Featuring special UV graphics with a colour-shift effect, this design changes with the light, showcasing the bike’s refined aesthetics and commanding attention from every angle.

y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.title: Serial Number
y16zr-6mro-limited-edition.description: Each Y16ZR Limited Edition bears a unique serial number, marking it as a prestigious collector’s item crafted with superior attention to detail.

mt-25.title: Meter Panel
mt-25.description: Next generation LCD meter panel with shift timing light and adequate easy read information.

mt-25.title: Front Fork
mt-25.description: All new inverted front forks and cast aluminium upper triple clamp provides confident cornering and braking performance.

mt-25.title: ABS Brakes
mt-25.description: Equipped with dual channel ABS system for front and rear brakes provides sure stopping power in all weather conditions.

mt-25.title: Air Scoop & Tank
mt-25.description: The legendary MT series air scoop directs air for effective cooling and the refined naked fuel tank gives it the mass forward body design.

mt-25.title: Tail Light
mt-25.description: LED technology provides brighter lighting with better energy savings and longer lasting.

mt-25.title: Turn Signal Indicators
mt-25.description: Slick and lightweight LED signal indicators with hazard lights function even when the ignition switch is off.

mt-25.title: Rear Lights
mt-25.description: Sophisticated rear LED lights provide a clear and distinct rear identity.

mt-25.title: Lamps
mt-25.description: First in its class hazard lamp for use during emergency situation.

mt-25.title: Motard Riding Position
mt-25.description: With low seat height, refined fuel tank incorporating sculpted knee area and high mounted handle bar to give it the motard and agile riding position.

mt-25.title: Lights and LED Headlight
mt-25.description: Predator type dual slant position lights emphasise the next generation MT look with the central mounted LED headlight to ensure bright and superior night riding.

image.alt: Dual Slant Position Lights and LED Headlight

mt-25.title: Front Suspension
mt-25.description: USD front fork with strength-rigidity balance offers better handling, stability, control and style.

mt-25.title: Swingarm
mt-25.description: Made of strong yet light weight material, enhancing handling of the motorcycle.

y16zr-doxou.title: Klac Lebih Pendek
y16zr-doxou.description: Kini 10mm lebih pendek, ianya mampu memberikan cengkaman yang singkat dan lebih selesa ketika menukar gear.

y16zr-doxou.title: Dengan VVA Serba Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Jantung penggerak paling berkuasa di kelasnya, enjin sejukan cecair 155cc serba baru, 4-lejang, 4-injap, SOHC dengan VVA.

y16zr-doxou.title: Dengan Pemetaan Pencucuhan Individu untuk Setiap Gear
y16zr-doxou.description: Menampilkan pemetaan pencucuhan yang berbeza untuk setiap gear, menghasilkan daya dorong 17.7Hp @ 9,500 rpm dan tork tertinggi 14.4 Nm @ 8,000 rpm.

image.alt: Gearbox 6 Kelajuan Dengan Pemetaan Pencucuhan Individu untuk Setiap Gear

y16zr-doxou.title: ‘Assist & Slipper’
y16zr-doxou.description: Terhubung ke gearbox, sistem klac A&S memastikan penukaran gear yang lebih lancar dan mengurangkan tahap bebanan klac untuk menghasilkan perjalanan yang lebih selesa.

y16zr-doxou.title: Serba Ringan
y16zr-doxou.description: Dilengkapi dengan kolar tetulang berbentuk Y baharu serta pendakap enjin yang lebih tebal, pada ketebalan 4.5mm. Ia memastikan tunggangan anda lebih mantap dan prestasi kawalan selekoh yang optimum biarpun pada kelajuan tinggi.

y16zr-doxou.title: 5.4 Liter Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Seiring dengan enjin yang cekap bahan api, Y16ZR mampu menawarkan jarak maksimum 256km dalam satu tangki penuh, berdasarkan pada gaya tunggangan anda.

y16zr-doxou.title: Kaliper 2-Pot Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Angkup brek dua piston pada roda hadapan menawarkan kestabilan ketika membrek dengan saiz brek cakera hadapan yang berukuran 245mm.

y16zr-doxou.title: Jenis Terpisah Gaya Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Rekaan pelana tempat duduk anti-gelincir yang ergonomik mengikut kontur duduk penunggang untuk tunggangan yang lebih selesa.

image.alt: Tempat Duduk Jenis Terpisah Gaya Baru

y16zr-doxou.title: Tinggi dan Rendah Berasingan
y16zr-doxou.description: Terinspirasi dari sukan permotoran, lampu depan sinar rendah terletak di bahagian bar pemegang sementara sinar tinggi disatukan dengan lampu posisi, di bahagian bawah, memberikan penampilan bahagian hadapan sporty yang tiada bandingannya.

image.alt: Lampu Depan LED Tinggi dan Rendah Berasingan

y16zr-doxou.title: Dengan Dasar Gelap
y16zr-doxou.description: Panel unit digital LCD baharu yang memaparkan semua informasi seperti kelajuan, tahap rpm, kedudukan gear, penunjuk VVA dan lain-lain pada dasar yang gelap, memberikan kontras grafik yang jelas.

image.alt: Meter Digital LCD Dengan Dasar Gelap

y16zr-doxou.title: LED Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Tampil lebih bergaya, lebih ramping, lebih runcing dengan rekaan lampu belakang LED inspirasi daripada model YZF-R1, ia disatukan dengan sempurna pada kontur badan motosikal.

y16zr-doxou.title: Pintar
y16zr-doxou.description: Enjin boleh dihidupkan dengan mudah hanya dengan memutar butang tanpa perlu memasukkan kunci. Sistem ini juga mempunyai fungsi ‘panggil-balik’ untuk mencari kedudukan motosikal. Dilengkapi ‘immobilizer’ untuk mencegah kecurian.

y16zr-doxou.title: 12V DC
y16zr-doxou.description: Untuk memudahkan anda mengecas apa saja peralatan pintar anda, soket DC 12V dengan maksimum kapasiti 1.0A disediakan.

y16zr-doxou.title: Enjin Baru
y16zr-doxou.description: Anda boleh mematikan enjin segera dengan hanya menekan suis khusus yang digabungkan dengan suis utama, sekiranya berlaku kecemasan, demi keselamatan anda.
